tokens.name: surface-window
tokens.usage: The browser frame: sidebar, toolbar and everything around the web page. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, ink-subtle.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Internal pages (new tab, settings, onboarding) and the empty web-view ground. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, brand.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, panels, the command bar, Glance, the active tab. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, ink-subtle, brand.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: The address field and search inputs set into the frame. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, ink-subtle.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface and on brand-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: URL path, tab hostnames, descriptions, on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, hints and inactive labels on every surface. Never for the only copy of a message.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between regions. Carries no meaning, so it may fall under 3:1.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (inputs, toggles, unchecked boxes). Meets 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one brand colour: shield, primary buttons, selected state, links. Text or icon on surface-window, surface-page and surface-raised.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills and brand text.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active segment, shield-on tint. Pair text with on-brand-soft or ink.

tokens.name: on-brand-soft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-soft.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caution text and icons (insecure page, broken-site risk) on warn-soft and surface-raised. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a caution banner.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons (certificate failure, deceptive site) on danger-soft and surface-raised. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error banner.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 2px solid, 2px offset. Meets 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: space-moss
tokens.usage: Space colour option. Marks only (dot, icon, outline), 3:1 on window and page.

tokens.name: space-clay
tokens.usage: Space colour option. Marks only.

tokens.name: space-sky
tokens.usage: Space colour option. Marks only.

tokens.name: space-sand
tokens.usage: Space colour option. Marks only.

tokens.name: space-plum
tokens.usage: Space colour option. Marks only.

tokens.name: space-slate
tokens.usage: Space colour option. Marks only.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, menu items, section labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints, shortcut keys, counters. Never below 11.5px.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Hostnames in the privacy report, keyboard keys, network log.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps inside a row.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tabs; padding inside chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding; gap between toolbar controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections in a panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page section gaps.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page margins on internal pages.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, kbd keys, chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tabs, address field, split panes, menu rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Popovers, command bar, Glance, cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggles, space dots, counters.

tokens.name: shadow-tab
tokens.usage: The active tab lifting off the sidebar.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, privacy panel, command bar.

tokens.name: shadow-glance
tokens.usage: Glance preview over the page.

layout.note: Fixed dimensions of the browser frame.

tokens.name: layout-sidebar
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar width (resizable 200 to 400).

tokens.name: layout-sidebar-compact
tokens.usage: Collapsed sidebar: favicons only.

tokens.name: layout-toolbar
tokens.usage: Top bar height when the sidebar is not hosting the address field.

tokens.name: layout-row
tokens.usage: Tab row, address field and menu row height.

tokens.name: layout-pane-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between split-view panes.
